# Fish Plate

GameCore theme sourced from a **real design object** in the Art Institute of Chicago.

## Work
- **Title:** Fish Plate
- **Artist / Maker:** Greek; Athens
- **Date:** 400-370 BCE
- **Style / Period:** greek
- **Classification:** plate (general, dish)
- **Department:** Arts of Greece, Rome, and Byzantium
- **AIC artwork ID:** 255
- **Artwork page:** https://www.artic.edu/artworks/255
- **Public-domain image:** https://www.artic.edu/iiif/2/41e76dfc-8322-cc90-121b-0cab281051d4/full/400,/0/default.jpg
